questions.question: In a psalm praising God's dwelling place, how does one day in God's courts compare with a day elsewhere?

answers.text: As good as a week elsewhere

questions.question: A psalm writer says he would rather live in the tents of the wicked than be a doorkeeper in God's house. True or false?
In a psalm praising God's house, the LORD withholds no good thing from which people?

answers.text: Those who bring the most offerings
Those who live closest to Zion
